newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-HEADLEY IS INJURY DOUBT FOR FOURTH TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-HEADLEY IS INJURY DOUBT FOR FOURTH TEST.

text.p: England paceman Dean Headley, who had an eight-wicket match haul against Australia on his test debut, may be doubtful for the fourth Ashes test.
Headley pulled out of Kent's county championship four-day match against Leicestershire at Canterbury on Wednesday, complaining of a side strain.
England coach David Lloyd said: "We are going to monitor the situation with both Kent and Dean Headley as to the extent of the injury with no thoughts on a replacement as yet."
Headley claimed match figures of eight for 176 on his debut in the third test earlier this month at Old Trafford, where England lost by 268 runs. The fourth test starts at Headingley on July 24.
